map.输入电机功率、转速、减速比与安全系数，计算输出扭矩并推荐型号: Enter motor power, speed, ratio and safety factor to compute output torque and recommend a model.
map.减速机选型：基于电机功率、输入转速、减速比与安全系数，按额定输出扭矩与热功率校核: Gear reducer selection: based on motor power, input speed, ratio and safety factor, check rated output torque and thermal power, pick a reducer from the standard series, for transmission design.
map.💡 输入扭矩 T1=9550×P/n1；输出扭矩 T2=T1×i×η；选型扭矩=: Formula: input torque T1=9550 times P/n1; output torque T2=T1 times i times eff; selection torque=T2 times safety factor.
map.蜗轮蜗杆减速比大但效率低，大功率不宜单级使用: Worm gear has large ratio but low efficiency; high power should not use single stage.
map.行星减速机结构紧凑、精度高，适用于伺服传动: Planetary reducer is compact and precise, suited for servo drives.
map.安全系数：均匀负载1.0-1.2，中等冲击1.3-1.5，重冲击1.6-2.0: Safety factor: uniform load 1.0-1.2, moderate shock 1.3-1.5, heavy shock 1.6-2.0.
map.📚 深度解析：减速机选型计算（扭矩、转速与机座号）: In-depth: Gear reducer selection calculation (torque, speed and frame size)
map.、转速与减速比算输出扭矩并定机座号: , speed and ratio compute output torque and frame size.
map.机型比较：对比斜齿轮、行星、蜗轮蜗杆与伞齿轮的效率差异: Type comparison: compare efficiency of helical, planetary, worm and bevel gears.
map.工况校核：按输出转速判断是否需要强制润滑与散热措施: Condition check: by output speed judge whether forced lubrication and cooling are needed.
map.算法：输入扭矩 T₁ = 9550×P/n₁（N·m）；输出扭矩 T₂ = T₁: Algorithm: input torque T1 = 9550 times P/n1 (N m); output torque T2 = T1 times i times eff; selection torque = T2 times safety factor SF; output speed n2 = n1/i. Frame recommendation: selection torque <100 N m small (RV/NMRV series), <500 medium (R/K/F/S series), <3000 large (ZLY/ZSY series), else extra-large/custom. Hints: n2<1 extremely low, mind cooling; n2<10 low speed needs forced lubrication; efficiency <0.8 low, <0.95 medium, else high.
map.例：5.5kW、1450rpm、i=20、SF=1.5、斜齿轮 η=0.96 →: Example: 5.5 kW, 1450 rpm, i=20, SF=1.5, helical eff=0.96 -> T1 36.22 N m, T2 695.50 N m, selection torque 1043.26 N m, n2 72.50 rpm, recommend large frame (e.g. ZLY/ZSY series), normal speed, high efficiency. If 1.5 kW, i=40, worm eff=0.80 -> T1 9.88 N m, T2 316.14 N m, selection torque 474.21 N m, n2 36.25 rpm, down to medium frame, medium efficiency. If i raised to 100 (eff=0.96) -> n2 14.50 rpm, selection torque 5216.28 N m, into extra-large/custom reducer range.
map.经验区间：斜齿轮/伞齿轮单级 0.96~0.98、行星 0.95~0.97、蜗轮: Empirical ranges: helical/bevel single stage 0.96 to 0.98, planetary 0.95 to 0.97, worm single stage 0.70 to 0.85 (lower at small lead angle, possible self-lock). Multi-stage should multiply each stage efficiency, not take the single-stage value, otherwise input-power demand is underestimated.
map.为什么低速输出要提强制润滑？: Why force lubrication at low output speed?
map.输出转速过低时齿轮啮合形成油膜的线速度不足，飞溅润滑无法把油带到齿面，易出现边界: At very low output speed the gear mesh line speed is insufficient for the oil film; splash lubrication cannot carry oil to the teeth, leading to boundary lubrication and scoring. Usually below 10 rpm output or low input speed, add forced oil injection or a heated oil bath; this tool warns accordingly.
map.减速机选型计算器根据电机功率、输入转速、减速比和安全系数，计算输入扭矩、输出扭矩: The gear reducer selection calculator, by motor power, input speed, ratio and safety factor, computes input, output and selection torque, and supports four types (helical, planetary, worm, bevel) to recommend a suitable frame series.
map.支持四种减速机类型及对应效率: Supports four reducer types and their efficiencies
map.按选型扭矩推荐机座号系列: Recommends frame series by selection torque
